"import json
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

# Build simple turbojet cycle and solve design point: SL static, MN~0, Fn=14000 lbf, T4=2900 R, OPR=16
prob = om.Problem()
prob.model = om.Group()  # Use Group instead of non-existent pyc.Element

# Components
prob.model.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightCondition())
prob.model.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
prob.model.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.AXI5))
prob.model.add_subsystem('burn', pyc.Combustor())
prob.model.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(map_data=pyc.LPT2269))
prob.model.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle())
prob.model.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft())
prob.model.add_subsystem('thrust', pyc.Thrust())

# Input defaults (SL static)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
prob.model.set_input_defaults('fc.MN', 0.0)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('fc.W', 100.0, units='lbm/s')
prob.model.set_input_defaults('inlet.ram_recovery', 1.0)

# Flow connections
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'fc.fl_out', 'inlet.fl_in')
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'inlet.fl_out', 'comp.fl_in')
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'comp.fl_out', 'burn.fl_in')
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'burn.fl_out', 'turb.fl_in')
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'turb.fl_out', 'noz.fl_in')
pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, 'noz.fl_out', 'thrust.fl_in')

# Mechanical shaft connections
prob.model.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_in')
prob.model.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_out')
prob.model.connect('shaft.HPX', 'comp.HPX')

# Thrust connections
prob.model.connect('fc.Fl_O', 'thrust.Fl_O')

# Design balance 1: shaft power (turbine drives compressor)
prob.model.add_subsystem('shaft_bal', pyc.Balance())
prob.model.connect('turb.power', 'shaft_bal.lhs')
prob.model.connect('comp.power', 'shaft_bal.rhs')
prob.model.connect('shaft_bal.x', 'turb.PR')
prob.model.set_val('shaft_bal.x', 4.0)

# Design balance 2: nozzle area (choked, mass flow matches)
prob.model.add_subsystem('noz_bal', pyc.Balance())
prob.model.connect('noz.mass_flow', 'noz_bal.lhs')
prob.model.connect('fc.W', 'noz_bal.rhs')
prob.model.connect('noz_bal.x', 'noz.Throat')
prob.model.set_val('noz_bal.x', 100.0, units='inch**2')

# Design balance 3: thrust target (drive W to hit Fn=14000 lbf)
prob.model.add_subsystem('fn_bal', pyc.Balance())
prob.model.connect('thrust.Fg', 'fn_bal.lhs')
prob.model.connect('fn_bal.x', 'fc.W')
prob.model.set_val('fn_bal.rhs', 14000.0, units='lbf')
prob.model.set_val('fn_bal.x', 100.0, units='lbm/s')

# Component design values
prob.set_val('comp.PR', 16.0)
prob.set_val('comp.eff', 0.9)
prob.set_val('comp.Nmech', 8000.0, units='rpm')
prob.set_val('burn.dPqP', 0.0)
prob.set_val('burn.eff', 0.99)
prob.set_val('burn.Tt4', 2900.0, units='degR')
prob.set_val('turb.eff', 0.9)
prob.set_val('turb.Nmech', 8000.0, units='rpm')
prob.set_val('noz.Cfg', 1.0)

# Solve design point
prob.setup()
prob.set_solver_print(level=-1)
prob.run_model()

# Extract results
Wfuel = prob.get_val('burn.Wfuel', units='lbm/s')[0]
Fn = prob.get_val('thrust.Fg', units='lbf')[0]
TSFC_hr = (Wfuel / Fn) * 3600.0  # lbm/(lbf*hr)

result = {
    'Fn_lbf': float(Fn),
    'TSFC': float(TSFC_hr),
    'OPR': float(prob.get_val('comp.PR')[0]),
    'Wfuel_lbm_s': float(Wfuel)
}

with open('result.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))"
